title: Everything Claude Code launches open-source 181-skill #ClaudeAI #AnthropicHackathon #AIDevelopment
description: Afan Mustafa open-sourced Everything Claude Code, a comprehensive Claude AI setup with 181 skills, 47 sub-agents, and 79 commands. Developed over 10 months and tested in real product work, it transforms Claude into a versatile developer team capable of security scanning, memory optimization, and learning from past sessions. Everything Claude Code integrates with Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, and Gemini, enabling rapid startup creation as demonstrated by the author winning the Anthropic Hackathon grand prize using this setup in just 8 hours. This innovation highlights the potential for AI-driven automation to accelerate software development and increase productivity. The open-source release provides valuable tools for developers seeking to leverage AI assistance across multiple coding platforms, showcasing a new benchmark in AI-powered developer ecosystems. Comment "setup" and I'll send you the guide and the link. #EverythingClaudeCode #AfanMustafa #AnthropicHackathon #ClaudeAI #AIProgramming #DeveloperTools #ArtificialIntelligence #Codex #CursorAI #GeminiAI #AIProductivity #OpenSourceAI #AIHackathon #SoftwareDevelopment #AIInnovation
